name: kestrel
description: Your own vidIQ-style research agent for YouTube and Instagram: outliers, creator breakdowns for Instagram, YouTube and X with a ready-to-say script, live video stats, impressions and CTR. Runs on your own API keys.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube Data API key
youtube_api_key.description: Free from Google Cloud Console (APIs and Services, Credentials). Kestrel's YouTube research runs on this key's daily quota.

instagram_token.title: Instagram Graph API token (optional)
instagram_token.description: Long-lived token from your own Meta app, linked to an Instagram Business or Creator account. Needed for Instagram tools and creator breakdowns.

instagram_user_id.title: Instagram user ID for that token (optional)
instagram_user_id.description: The numeric instagram_business_account id of the account the token belongs to. The README shows how to find it.

my_instagram.title: Your Instagram username (optional)
my_instagram.description: Creator breakdowns compare the creator with this account and write advice for it. Leave empty to skip the comparison.

follow_handle.title: Handle on the breakdown's end card (optional)
follow_handle.description: The animated breakdown ends with 'Follow @<this>'. Leave empty to show 'Built with Kestrel'.
